useCases: Native and fast. No Electron or webviews. Opens instantly and stays responsive on large views.
Lightweight. Wu's memory footprint is lower than VS Code and Zed. See benchmarks.
Coding agents included. Built-in support for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode.
readmeSummary: Wu is a fast, native code editor written in Rust, with a clean, modern design and coding agents built in.
